optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Rollout Project Manager, Warehouse Robotics Deployment

professionalSummary.text: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.
professionalSummary.witness: Took nine customer warehouses live on the goods-to-person robotics system between 2021 and 2025, running the cut-over from manual picking at each site over a weekend and the first live picking shift on the Monday morning.

professionalSummary.text: Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the hypercare fortnight at all nine sites with the customer's shift leaders and handled the stoppages raised during hypercare; the stoppage log for each site records the cause, the fix and who cleared it.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering for each site in the six weeks before go-live, holding the weekly installation review with the field lead.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the installation schedule with field engineering for each site in the six weeks before go-live, holding the weekly installation review with the field lead.

professionalSummary.text: Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-go-live acceptance tests with the customer on the installed system at each site, with the acceptance record signed by the customer's operations manager before cut-over.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the site closure report for each warehouse, listing the known limitations of the system at that site, the open items for remote support and the hand-over conditions agreed with the customer.
